★Request
Change viewpoint: McQueen in the lead, Ryan trailing behind

■Direction
*Mejiro Ryan at around 7 years old.

They've entered the final stretch! McQueen in the lead, Ryan in pursuit!
Both unleash their final burst, locking their sights on the goal!!

By a razor-thin—truly microscopic margin,
Mejiro McQueen claimed victory.
(Still...! Not once did I ever think, "It's okay to lose"!!)
Me too! I'll always, always be cheering for you!!
—Ryan, let me ask you once more.
Today is finally the day of the track meet.

(When did I start doubting if it was okay to want to win?
When did looking at you make me lose sight of that... When did it start...?)
...! Ryan, you...
McQueen...

Now, the Umamusume are all in the gates—
and the 3,200m turf tournament race is underway!!

*sigh*... Ahhh, I lost!!
———Dammit, it hurts so much!!
(That's why I thought... if it's you... if it's someone like you...)

The crowd is putting extra passion into their cheers today.
And of course—

(No! That's not it! I...!! It's true that
I doubted whether I was allowed to want to win, but...!!)

If all I wanted was to move my body, I could do that anywhere.
If working out was enough, I wouldn't need to race at all.

(Even now! In every single race!
Even way back then, when we raced as kids, I—!!)
Would you become my Trainer, and mine alone!?
So tell me, do you believe it is fine to lose?
It's a massive event for Tracen Academy, drawing attention from all over the country.

Um, so... So, you see.
Only if you're okay with it, Trainer, but...!

You got this, Ryan!!
I'm definitely gonna be there to see you win!!

If your opponent runs with a noble, honorable purpose,
do you truly believe it is acceptable to lose... Is that how you feel, Ryan?
That's why I came here... to *win*.

McQueen, you asked me
why I came to Tracen Academy, right?

WOOOOOOOOAAAH!!
HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

Mejiro Ryan accelerates here!
She's fast, she's ferocious, charging up from behind!

To train, to run, to compete, and to become faster than anyone else.
...McQueen, to beat strong Umamusume like you, too.
—As a Mejiro, I cannot afford an unsightly display.

Hehe... In that case, I shall face you with everything I have.
For I, too, as a Mejiro Umamusume, intend to win.

(I've watched you by your side since before I can remember.
Your resolve, your efforts, your setbacks, your triumphs...)

...Wait, huh? Um, did that just sound like a love confession?
Like, "mine alone"... Wah... Wawawawa...!!
Yay! I came in first place!!

McQueen-san, Ryan-san!
Please get ready to enter the track!!

McQueen! Show 'em what you've got!
We're expecting a run worthy of the Mejiro name!
Why did you come to Tracen Academy?

Haha!
—When it comes to training hard, I won't lose to anyone either.
As always, quite a large crowd has gathered.
And just like that, I became the Trainer for the refreshing, healthy Umamusume, Mejiro Ryan...!

Yeah... You really are amazing, McQueen.
Always fulfilling your duties like that—
Huh...?

Ryaaannn, do your best!!
Ryan, we're rooting for youuuuu!!
Whoa... Ehehe... Thank you so much, everyone!!

(McQueen... the girl I've always admired.
Carrying all the poise and dignity expected of a true heir to the prestigious Mejiro family...)
With this body, with these legs... I'm going as far as I possibly can!!

1,000 meters remaining, the pack is stretching out! McQueen is in the lead group,
while Ryan is holding back—though her stride seems to lack some punch!?

(Did I start thinking...
that losing was fine...?)
(—When did it start?)
—AAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!

All eyes are on these two, of course!
Hailing from the prestigious Mejiro family, Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan!
Waaahhh!! Forget that, please just forgeeeet itttt!!
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...

—GOOOOOAAAAAL!!
The crowd erupts over this heart-pounding photo finish!!

Trainer...
Thank you for helping me realize what's truly important.
